subject.title: fix(proxy): bound managed proxy CA file reads

question: Should managed-proxy CA bundles be capped at 256 KiB, or raised to a compatibility-oriented ceiling before merge?
rationale: This changes a previously unbounded shipped configuration path into a startup rejection, and repository evidence does not define a maximum supported CA-bundle size.

options.title: Raise the ceiling
options.body: Use an evidence-backed limit such as 1 MiB, retain the bounded reader, and prove an OS-plus-enterprise bundle and oversized rejection through the real proxy path.

options.title: Accept 256 KiB
options.body: Keep the proposed ceiling only with explicit owner acceptance and upgrade proof showing that supported managed-proxy CA bundle layouts remain below it.

options.title: Pause for shared policy
options.body: Defer this PR until OpenClaw defines a common certificate and CA-bundle size policy across managed proxy, MCP, and plugin TLS readers.

recommendation.title: Raise the ceiling
recommendation.body: Use an evidence-backed limit such as 1 MiB, retain the bounded reader, and prove an OS-plus-enterprise bundle and oversized rejection through the real proxy path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and live-tested the managed HTTPS proxy CA trust contract now being narrowed.
